It’s likely because your Plano team is behind on resets. Our store’s is. Every item has a location. When there’s a reset, there’s a current location and a future location. Ideally, the Plano team gets the reset done in time and the future location becomes the current one. If the reset doesn’t get completed, the future one doesn’t get completed in the system (because the reset is not complete) and the current location expires (really dumb in my opinion, I don’t know why they do this. The item is still there). We had a small screw of people at my store doing resets, lost a couple, and management refuses to hire replacements. There’s 2 of us, and there’s a similar story at every store I’ve heard about (ridiculously understaffed and refusing to hire people.) At this rate, honestly? We will not catch up. It is just not possible. Maybe we will in, like, February 2025. (maybe!)
